verdict.rationale: Clara documents creating virtual cards via API that are active immediately, with full create/update/lock/delete control. Its Card Configurations API adds merchant-category, time and day-of-week restrictions, so a finance lead can issue a dedicated, category-restricted card per vendor. Restrictions are documented only at merchant-category level, not locked to a single merchant, so the single-vendor isolation promise is only approximated. Missing for 10: merchant-specific (single-vendor) card locking, explicit per-vendor spend limits, SaaS/subscription-oriented guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
